scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical with a stand-alone finite random-matrix checking program; finite tests are not proofs of distributional or limiting identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to rank-one-complement Hermitian projectors, square circular-complex Gaussian sketches, and the specified nonpersistent eigenvalue branch. Results do not extend automatically to nonprojector spectra, oversampling, real sketches, finite precision, or robust aggregation. Exact marginal distributions do not imply independence.
title: Exact Gaussian Ritz risk laws for a rank-one spectral projector
